insight: YC S19 alum; open-sourced its notebook under Apache 2.0 in 2025, pitching itself as the 'successor to Jupyter.'
name: Deepnote
tagline: AI-native collaborative notebook for data teams.
description: Collaborative data notebook positioned as a drop-in Jupyter replacement: real-time multiplayer editing, SQL + Python + R blocks, warehouse integrations (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift), and notebooks that deploy as data apps and dashboards. Deepnote AI generates, fixes, and explains code, and an agent can run analyses autonomously.

modelSupport.notes: Deepnote AI generates SQL/Python in-notebook; Enterprise plans can bring their own LLM.

edge: A drop-in Jupyter replacement that adds real-time collaboration, native SQL blocks, and one-click data apps.
pros: AI code generation and an autonomous agent
Notebooks deploy as data apps & dashboards
cons: Free plan caps editors, projects, and AI use
Premium connectors gated to paid plans

references.title: Deepnote, a 'Successor to Jupyter Notebook,' Goes Open Source
